summary: Wrote dft/dft_plan.md with six sections: test strategy, scan approach, test pins, expected coverage method, memory test approach, limitations of the open flow. Phase 0 recommendation: no scan (the flow cannot insert it, and the 12 output flops are already loadable from and observable at the pins); pin-based functional, reset, CMP-hold and at-speed tests; no added test pins; coverage to be measured later by real fault simulation/ATPG on the gate netlist; no memories so no MBIST. No coverage number is stated.
assumptions: Fault (open-source DFT tool) is mentioned only as an option; it is not part of the current flow and was not run.
No test pins may be added without a spec change; Phase 1 scan pins are proposals only.
The design has no memories and exactly 12 flops, per arch.yaml; flop count in the netlist was not independently verified by me.
sky130_fd_sc_hd scan flops (sdfxtp family) are suitable for Phase 1 scan; not verified against the library in this task.
open_issues: Adding scan pins (scan_en, scan_in, scan_out) in Phase 1 would change the spec pinout and needs human approval.
No fault simulation or ATPG has run; stuck-at and transition coverage are unknown until a real tool runs (Phase 1).
reports/synth_tool.json uses a 4.0 ns input external delay while spec.yaml assumes 0 ns external I/O delay; the timing owner should reconcile, as it affects at-speed tester timing.

self_assessment.reason: All six required sections are present, the plan follows directly from the given spec/arch/synthesis inputs, and no coverage figure or tool result is claimed.
